entry.description: A filter decision outside `Deny`, `Neutral` and `Accept` no longer hangs the appender. The filter loop never moved on from such a decision, so a `StringMatchFilter` with a `timeoutDecision` of `5`, once a regex match timed out, or a custom filter returning such a value stopped logging through that appender and its shutdown. An unknown decision now counts as `Neutral`, and `StringMatchFilter.TimeoutDecision` rejects one: from configuration it is reported and the default `Neutral` kept (ANT-2026-VKBDETLN, fixed by @FreeAndNil)
